_comment: One canonical orkest skill projects with byte identity to all three named harnesses. Roots are project-relative and shared roots are written once. Grok uses its native .grok projection; fallback discovery order is not asserted. Only proven owned legacy copies may be retired; local/custom skills remain conflicts. `aliases` are short names of the same suite skill, projected and installed beside it; they are not legacy stubs and are never counted as extra skills.
